svg.aria-label: Who I am: I lead, I sell, and I build. Recent hands-on work includes multi-agent AI systems with persistent memory, LLM evaluation and drift-testing harnesses, and governed demo pipelines, written in Go, Python, and Swift, plus NVIDIA NIM deployed on Kubernetes. In a pursuit, that lets me shape the solution with the delivery team and pressure-test it before an operator's CIO does. I decide where model judgment ends and deterministic code takes over, then back it with paired evals and a cost model before the client commits.
